developer: Hampton Technology Park Owner, LLC c/o Dillard Sellers
status_detail: Georgia DCA DRI #4624 lists Hampton Technology Park as a technological facility including data centers in Hampton, Henry County. The initial form describes five buildings totaling 4,000,000 sq ft on about 603.56 acres; the Part 2 form lists $12B estimated value at build-out, 150 FTEs, Georgia Power, 1,500 MW peak connected load, and completion in 2033. DRI status is Completed with RDC finding dated June 16, 2026.
notes: Separate from the smaller 133-acre Henderson Farms/Hampton data center approved in 2025; DRI says this is a continuation/expansion of prior Lower Woolsey Henry 780 DRI #2808.

status_detail: Hampton officials approved a conditional use permit in March 2025 for a 133-acre data center campus north of Georgia 20 at McDonough Street within the larger Henderson Farms mixed-use development; Henry GA News called it the first data center in Henry County. Plateau Excavation lists the project as a Hampton Data Center mission-critical job with three approximately 195,000 sq ft buildings and substation; FOX 5 reported in August 2026 that crews are currently constructing a massive data center near South Lee Road and Lower Woolsey Road.
notes: Capacity not found in official/current public sources reviewed; project scope reported as 133 acres and three data center buildings.

status_detail: Georgia DCA DRI #4689 lists Project Arrowhead in Irwin County as a technological facility including data centers. The initial form describes five properties for a data center campus totaling 4,220,000 sq ft on approximately 1,066 acres, with phase completion in 2030 and overall completion in 2034. Part 2 lists $6B estimated build-out value, $20M annual local tax revenue, 200 FTEs, Georgia Power, and 1,250 MW peak connected electrical load. DRI status is Completed with RDC finding dated May 14, 2026.
notes: DCD/WWALS report the project partly overlaps land previously earmarked for Irwin Forward Tech Park, a separate/earlier data center proposal withdrawn before Project Arrowhead filing.

aliases: Northern Data Group Maysville HPC data center
status_detail: Northern Data Group announced on Dec. 4, 2024 a best-in-class AI/HPC data center in Maysville, Georgia, expected to deliver 120 MW near-term with expansion potential to 180 MW, create up to 100 jobs, occupy a 63-acre site, and be fully operational in Q1 2027. The company quoted a Maysville City Council representative saying the project supports business growth in Jackson County; Data Center Dynamics also reported design/construction activity for the Maysville site.
notes: Project Orchid in Jefferson/Jackson County was reviewed as a false positive: DCA/Bisnow identify it as a metal manufacturing/industrial proposal by Pattillo, not a data center, and local reports say it was later pulled.

project_name: Unnamed Jasper County / Monticello data center proposal
status_detail: Local news reported in July-August 2026 that residents and officials were debating a possible hyperscale data center tied to proposed City of Monticello annexation of large parcels around the Mine Lake property; 41NBC reported organizers claimed NDA-bound sources linked Meta to land in Jasper County and another site in Jackson, Georgia. WGXA reported Jasper County commissioners voted to block the Monticello land annexation after a public hearing, and later reported Development Authority debate/community pushback; the Monticello News quoted the Development Authority saying no company was currently under consideration for the Mine Lake parcels. No DCA DRI or official developer/capacity found.
notes: Included under 'early/rumored' standard; developer and Meta link remain unconfirmed, and county action appears focused on annexation/jurisdiction rather than formal project approval.

status_detail: No Jefferson County GA data center project found. Georgia DCA shows a withdrawn DRI #4630 in Jefferson County named Project Orchid, but its forms identify an industrial/metal manufacturing building by Pattillo Industrial Real Estate, not a data center; the related completed Project Orchid DRI #4640 is in the City of Jefferson/Jackson County and also describes an industrial/metal manufacturing facility.
